# ImprovTalk

> A voice-first AI communication coach. You hold a button and talk to an AI
> conversation partner out loud, then get scored on what you said and how you
> said it. iPhone.

ImprovTalk is a mobile app for practising real conversations — small talk,
interviews, networking, storytelling, tough feedback, and meeting new people —
by actually speaking them, not by reading about them.

## What makes it different

- **You speak; it speaks back.** Live voice, in real time, over WebRTC. There is
  no typing mode.
- **Three conversation languages.** A session can run in English, Spanish or
  Russian. The AI partner replies only in the language you picked, and the
  written feedback comes back in that same language. (The app's own interface is
  English only.)
- **The score shows its work.** Every number opens to the measurements behind
  it, for example "7 fillers in 3 minutes; pace 142 wpm; target band 130-160".
- **No social risk.** You practise alone, on your phone, on your own schedule,
  as many times as you want.

## How the score works

Charisma Score = Fluency x 0.40 + Confidence x 0.35 + Improvisation x 0.25.

Those three pillars are graded against a fixed rubric, then blended with the
measured delivery score, which counts for a quarter of the total. Delivery
metrics — pace, pauses, filler count, pitch and volume steadiness — come from
acoustic analysis of the audio (librosa and Parselmouth/Praat) and are
deterministic for the same recording. The rubric half is a model judgement made
the same way every time, not a measurement. Lexical diversity uses MATTR and
MTLD.

## What is in it

- 70 live practice scenarios across 13 venues
- 210 AI-vs-AI simulator scenarios across 19 venues
- 2,766 reference items across 22 catalogues (countries, accents, films, music,
  art, professions, gestures and more)
- 195 nationalities and 29 accents, which shape who the AI partner is and how
  she sounds in English — they do not change the conversation language
- 16 solo drills including behavioural interview, networking, storytelling,
  tough feedback, light debate and rejection recovery

## Privacy

Your voice is used to score the session and nothing else. The microphone is not
active outside a session screen. Transcripts and scores are kept until you
delete them; deleting the account removes them. No contacts, calendar, photos or
location are collected, and the app ships no advertising or analytics SDKs.
Users can export or delete everything.

## Pricing

Free to start, with 3 AI conversations a week. Paid tiers raise the limit. Final
pricing is confirmed at launch.

## Status

Pre-launch, in TestFlight beta on iPhone. Not yet listed on the App Store.
